research_basis.question: Does mandatory planning-time slicing improve implementation quality or efficiency in an AI coding workflow, and when should it be removed, retained, or repurposed?
research_basis.method: Five independent delegated lenses and a distinct peer; three required synthesis qualifications applied.
limitations: No matched local ablation isolates mandatory slicing from model, delegation, verification and review.
The repository inspection traces contracts and handoff artifacts; native runtime compliance and time saved were not independently audited.
The 659-line example is one current task and cannot estimate representative overhead; some duplication may be intentional for handoffs.
External studies and vendor reports use different tasks, older models or bundled changes; transfer and effect size remain uncertain.

primary_sources.verification: Opened during preceding research in this chat; engineering report, not a same-model slicing ablation.
